decisions.title: Bernalillo County / International Sunport Station Area Sector Development Plan
decisions.description: Establishes a transit-oriented development framework around the Rail Runner station near the Sunport, covering land use, street connections, walking and bicycling, public spaces, development standards, implementation, and coordination with surrounding Albuquerque destinations.

decisions.title: Rio Metro / ABQ RIDE Consolidation Study Final Report
decisions.description: Evaluates governance options for ABQ RIDE and Rio Metro, rejects full consolidation as unnecessarily disruptive, and recommends greater ABQ RIDE autonomy, improved Rio Metro regional planning, coordinated demand-response service, and a more integrated transit network.
decisions.large_file_assessment: The final 102-page report is 25,114,690 bytes (23.95 MiB), crossing the project's 25-million-byte warning point but remaining well below 100 MB. Its graphics, tables, appendices, and full existing-conditions analysis explain the size. A slightly smaller draft exists, but no smaller authoritative final version was located; optimization would alter the source, so the original final report is preserved unchanged.

decisions.title: New Mexico Rail Runner Express Project Development History
decisions.description: Documents how the Belen-to-Santa Fe commuter rail system was planned and delivered, including route selection, station development, rolling-stock acquisition, BNSF negotiations, service design, environmental review, public involvement, construction, and capital and operating costs.

decisions.title: NMRX Grade Crossing Pedestrian and Bicyclist Safety Study
decisions.description: Provides a systemwide toolbox for safer walking and bicycling at Rail Runner crossings, including passive and active devices, barrier and signal treatments, an evaluation form, minimum requirements, and standard applications for common crossing configurations.

decisions.title: Rail Runner Operations and Maintenance Facility Fact Sheet
decisions.description: Summarizes the planned Downtown Albuquerque facility replacing Rail Runner's aging outdoor maintenance site, with an indoor repair shop, inspection and storage tracks, offices, environmental controls, improved working conditions, and capacity for more reliable service.

decisions.title: Paseo del Norte High-Capacity Transit Study: Alternatives Analysis Report
decisions.description: Evaluates high-capacity transit across Albuquerque's Paseo del Norte corridor and recommends a phased bus rapid transit alternative, with alignment screening, ridership forecasts, conceptual design, costs, funding, land-use considerations, public input, and implementation steps.

decisions.title: Rio Metro Double Track Study
decisions.description: Identifies passing sidings, double-track segments, station platforms, phasing, and coordination needed to support more frequent and reliable all-day Rail Runner service, including regular schedules and greater resilience when trains are delayed.

decisions.title: Rio Metro Budget and Capital Plan, FY2027-FY2031
decisions.description: Details current Rail Runner operating budgets, five-year maintenance and capital priorities, transit vehicle needs, funding sources, unfunded projects, and FY2027 goals, led by construction of the Albuquerque operations and maintenance facility.

decisions.title: Rio Metro Regional Transit District Short Range Plan, FY2012-FY2017
decisions.description: Preserves an early systemwide plan covering Rio Metro's institutional history, Rail Runner and bus operations, ridership and service performance, stations and capital assets, financial projections, expansion priorities, and relationships to regional transportation plans.

decisions.title: New Mexico State Rail Plan
decisions.description: Provides the current statewide passenger and freight rail inventory, including Rail Runner service, stations, connections, ownership, safety, funding, trends, needs, goals, and the prioritized Rail Service and Investment Program.

decisions.title: UNM/CNM/Sunport Transit Study: Alternative Alignments Identification and Assessment
decisions.description: Compares transit alignments linking UNM, CNM, major medical and employment destinations, and the Sunport, then recommends a University-Gibson bus rapid transit alternative using ridership, cost, traffic, right-of-way, and community-impact analysis.

decisions.title: Rail Runner Rail and Bus Connections Guide
decisions.description: Maps Rail Runner stations and connecting transit services, including ABQ RIDE, Rio Metro, Santa Fe Trails, North Central Regional Transit District, NMDOT Park and Ride, airport access, and station-specific transfer information.

decisions.title: Rail Runner System Map
decisions.description: Shows the full Belen-to-Santa Fe Rail Runner corridor, all stations, major roads, pueblos, station parking, airport connections, and the portions of the route owned by NMDOT and BNSF.
